email_body:
Hello Justin,

I'm applying for the Civil Works Project Officer role in your Development and Civil Engineering team, which I found on the Yarra City Council careers site. Your name is on the advert, so I wanted to reach you directly as well.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day and writing progress reports. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

Your advert describes scoping and inspecting reinstatement works on Council roads and footpaths and guiding contractors to Council standards, which suits how I like to work. I'm based in Melton VIC with a licence and my own transport, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked for a council yet, so I would bring site discipline and learn your Road Management Plan quickly.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Civil Works Project Officer
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Works Project Officer role in your Development and Civil Engineering team. Scoping reinstatement works, inspecting contractors' work on Council roads and footpaths and checking it against Council standards is the practical, site based work I want to do in local government.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). My coursework included Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designing around existing services and site constraints.

I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton VIC. I have not yet worked for a council or in Australia, so I would learn your Road Management Plan, permits and specifications quickly and keep clear records for every inspection.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
